### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

Allow yourself to fully focus on your product and let us focus on what we do best – the performance,
aesthetics and functionality of the coating of your product.

## Energy solutions

Our PVD technology offers clean coating processes and allows the production of high-performing fuel
cell and electrolyzer coatings optimized for energy efficiency and long durability.

Our delivery models are flexible to meet the production needs in all development stages, which
supports new energy solutions based on fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies to scale up with
maximum control in each production phase. 

[Explore energy solutions][56]

## Metallization solutions

Impact Coatings’ solutions for plastic metallization provide unique quality control and cost
efficiency, required by modern manufacturing in the plastic and automotive industries.

PVD metallization of plastic products is growing industry-wide and plays an important role in the
phase-out of hazardous hexa­valent chromium used in traditional plating on plastic.

[Explore metallization solutions][57]

Presto Restoration Products & Services specializes in commercial waterproofing services for glass,
metal and stone surfaces in Albuquerque, NM. 

Presto has decades of experience protecting commercial buildings and helping them look their best.
Waterproofing the exterior of a commercial building is one of the best ways to ensure both. Our
industry leading commercial building waterproofing services include the application of various types
of caulking and coating on all exterior surfaces. Our expert commercial building waterproofing
contractors will apply a durable and long-lasting protective barrier.

Professional waterproofing services are the most cost-effective way to protect your commercial
building. Water damage to the exterior of the building and leaks can be costly to repair. Leaks can
lead to even more problems like mold and high energy bills. Don’t’ waste time and money chasing
leaks after they happen, find a professional you can trust. We are the leading Albuquerque, NM
commercial building waterproofing services provider no matter the surface or façade type. 

Our expertise comes from working with Albuquerque, NM commercial building owners and property
managers on all types of commercial buildings. We have protected condominiums, hotels, office
buildings, entertainment venues, and parking garages. We handle all large-scale commercial
waterproofing projects on everything from new construction to historic buildings. 

Call us today to learn more about how our commercial building waterproofing services can keep your
commercial building protected and looking its best.

## Aerospace

### Engineered for Performance

management for the aviation industries.

### Forefront of Innovation

Combining PPG’s expertise in coatings and technologies to aid automakers around the world in
enhancing the image and identity of their vehicle brands.

Learn More

## Automotive Refinish

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish
business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

## Industrial Coatings

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts
to provide the innovative coatings that enhance the products we use every day.

Learn More

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

## Protective & Marine Coatings

### Unrivaled Performance

Developing products that protect customers’ assets in some of the world’s most demanding conditions
and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

### Performance that protects

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

Learn More

Learn More

## Filtration Technologies


An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and
wastewater more efficient and economical.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

### Building Envelope Systems for Any Project

Our building material systems are designed to work together for a continuous, air-tight and
waterproof solution in the most extreme environmental conditions.



Air Barrier Systems

Comprehensive air barrier systems protecting against air and moisture infiltration with self-adhered
and fluid-applied membranes, sealants, flashings and transition assemblies.

Commercial Glazing Systems

Everything you need for air- and watertight fenestration and wall assemblies in new construction or
restoration applications.  

Traffic Systems

Liquid-applied waterproofing membranes for vehicular and pedestrian applications, delivering
long-term durability in high-traffic areas.

Waterproofing

We provide fluid-applied, sheet-applied, and hybrid waterproofing systems with primers, drainage,
and other accessories for maximum below-grade protection.

PUMA Technology

Traffic and waterproofing systems featuring PUMA (polyurethane-methacrylate) technology for
exceptional abrasion resistance, crack-bridging and fast cure.

APOC is the destination for professional grade commercial and residential building products of all
kinds - roof coatings, adhesives, waterproofing solutions and more.

[Qualified Mesa shingle roofers]

#### Shingle Roofs

At Arizona Roofing Systems, we are highly skilled and experienced in shingle roof services. Shingle
roofs are an attractive and cost-effective choice for many homeowners and businesses in Arizona.
Shingle roofs are durable, weather-resistant, and can effectively protect your building from
Arizona’s harsh sun and occasional heavy rains.

[Experienced Mesa tile roofers]

#### Tile Roofs

Tile roofs are a distinctive feature of many homes and commercial buildings in Arizona, offering
exceptional beauty, durability, and longevity. Our team of professionals understands the unique
challenges and requirements of installing tile roofs. Trust us to handle your tile roof repair,
replacement, or installation with meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality.

[Foam Roof Installation]

#### Foam Roofs

As a leader in roofing solutions, Arizona Roofing Systems also offers foam roofing services. Foam
roofs, known for their excellent insulation properties and waterproof capabilities, are a popular
choice for many Arizona residents. This type of roofing system helps to reduce energy costs and
protect your building from heat and UV damage.

[Mesa flat and foam roof installation]

#### Flat Roofing

Specializing in flat roofing systems, Arizona Roofing Systems provides expert solutions tailored to
the unique needs of flat roofs. This type of roofing is common in commercial buildings, but is also
found in residential structures in Arizona. From small-scale repairs to large-scale installations
and replacements, we ensure a smooth and efficient process.

single-ply roofing systems are highly favored in commercial settings due to their durability, energy
efficiency, and resistance to UV rays, chemicals, and fire. Our team has extensive knowledge and
expertise in TPO/PVC roof installations, repairs, and maintenance.

## PREFERRED SUPPLIER

Boero YachtCoatings are the preferred choice, as we ensure our customers have the best custom
coating solutions, from the full and versatile range of product, superior performance for any type
of substrate, application and conditions, all supported by the Boero technical team and product
warranty

### Boero LifeCycle

An integrated and comprehensive range of customised coating solutions and services to meet the most
complex requirements.

We promote the Boero LifeCycle with a dedicated team, focused on the best maintenance and aftersales
service to superyacht: shipyards, captains and management, offering global support, product
information and service. We support the Boero LifeCycle with our technical services, offering
practical coatings advice, specification, inspection and various levels of training.

[Discover Boero LifeCycle][41]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Boero Technical Service

Boero YachtCoatings actively engages in customer service by taking our involvement with our
customers past the point of the actual sale of our products into the shipyard, dry dock,
construction site and workshops to assist our customers obtain the required coating finish and to
conform to the project coating specification.
Boero YachtCoatings achieves this in field service by employing a dedicated group of qualified
staff, known as Boero Coating Advisors. Boero Coating Advisors are located in most of the markets
where Boero YachtCoatings is promoting and selling products, being part of the local technical
service team and report to the local Technical Service Manager.

[Discover Techical Services][42]
[Boero YachtCoatings]

### Full range of products

Boero YachtCoatings has a comprehensive range of products and coating solutions that cover all
requirements for both yacht and superyacht painting. Coatings that cover above and below waterline,
exterior and interior systems and all types of tanks and specialist areas.
With a variety of product options in each product group: Anti-fouling, Fillers, Primers, Tank
coatings and Topcoats – Boero YachtCoatings has a coating solution to suit all needs, offering
performance in the most demanding of environments.
Boero YachtCoatings offer complete coating systems to suit a variety of uses, application,
environmental conditions and expected finish.

# Colorama Coatings

### Not just paint, but real protection

Over the past 25 years we have developed an extensive range of high-quality paints and coatings
utilising the latest manufacturing technology aided by a strong research and development ethos. Our
products are used in a number of industrial, retail, housing and hospitality settings in Egypt and
around the world.

## Pioneering excellence in coatings Since 1997

Founded in 1997 with the establishment of our paints factory in Borg El Arab Industrial City,
Alexandria, Egypt, Colorama Coatings has evolved into a key player in the coatings industry in
Egypt. Through strategic collaborations with leading European and American multinational companies,
we’ve expanded our product range beyond architectural and decorative paints to include specialised
industrial, protective, and marine coating systems. Our commitment to quality through innovation has
driven our continuous growth, transforming Colorama into an agile organisation capable of swiftly
responding to market demands and customer requirements.

## Innovation-driven quality protection coatings

Today, Colorama Coatings stands as a leader in protection technology, made possible by our dedicated
R&D team in Egypt and partnerships with premier formulators across Europe and the USA. This ardent
focus on research enables us to develop bespoke solutions for any coating challenge, precisely
tailored to fulfil diverse customer specifications. Our elastomeric coatings rival those of
internationally renowned brands, delivering equivalent performance at competitive value. Advanced
thermal and waterproofing coating systems represent the latest addition to our comprehensive product
portfolio, specifically engineered to meet the rigorous demands of the petrochemical and energy
industries.

## CERTIFCATES

## Our products

###### Resins & Alkyds

We supply high quality alkyds to our coatings’ plants and other customers as well as epoxy,
polyurethane and acrylic resin.

###### Wood coatings

We produce a range of wood paints and varnishes designed for enhancing appearance, durability and
performance.

[ DETAILS ][49]

###### Decorative coatings

Our acclaimed and versatile interior and exterior range of paints are designed for durability and
harsh environmental conditions.

[ DETAILS ][50]

###### Roof coatings

Our Elastomeric and Acrylic roof coatings offer an excellent protective layer and are designed to
enhance performance, appearance and durability.

[ DETAILS ][51]

###### Marine coatings

Marine coatings are specialised protective paints designed to safeguard ships, boats, and offshore
structures from harsh marine environments.

[ DETAILS ][52]

###### Industrial coatings

Our industrial coatings range is used in various applications including protection from corrosion,
chemical and environmental damage.

[ DETAILS ][53]

###### Thermal insulation coatings

These coating are designed to provide thermal protection for tanks, vessels, boilers, pipelines as
well as roof and warehouse insulation.

[ DETAILS ][54]

###### Fireproofing coatings

We supply fire protection water-based acrylic intumescent paints for protecting structural steel as
well as epoxies for wood and textile protection.

[ DETAILS ][55]

###### Floor coatings

Our floor coatings provide enhanced performance, appearance and durability for factory floors and
other heavily trafficked areas.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production

Welcome to Impact Coatings

# Clean PVD coating solutions for a safe and sustainable society

## Explore our core areas of coating expertise, perfectly matched to your application.

Allow yourself to fully focus on your product and let us focus on what we do best – the performance,
aesthetics and functionality of the coating of your product.

## Energy solutions

Our PVD technology offers clean coating processes and allows the production of high-performing fuel
cell and electrolyzer coatings optimized for energy efficiency and long durability.

Our delivery models are flexible to meet the production needs in all development stages, which
supports new energy solutions based on fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies to scale up with
maximum control in each production phase. 

[Explore energy solutions][56]

## Metallization solutions

Impact Coatings’ solutions for plastic metallization provide unique quality control and cost
efficiency, required by modern manufacturing in the plastic and automotive industries.

PVD metallization of plastic products is growing industry-wide and plays an important role in the
phase-out of hazardous hexa­valent chromium used in traditional plating on plastic.

[Explore metallization solutions][57]

## Take advantage of three decades of experience in tailored coating solutions. We can help you
## modify look, feel, conductivity, and wear resistance to meet your unique application needs.

[Discover more applications][58]

## Impact Coatings is your well-rounded partner for coating systems, service and delivery.

At Impact Coatings we always put the customer in the center. We listen to, and work closely with you
in order to provide the solutions that best meet your PVD coating needs today and in the future.

### PVD systems

### Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings

**Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings** based on asphaltic-bituminous emulsion and polymer hybrids are
functional products used on specific applications, requiring certain performance characteristics.

[Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers]

### Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers

**Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers** based on hybrid systems of Silane, Siloxane, Flourinated,
Lithium and Potassium Silicates are ideal for water repellency, anti-graffiti (non-sacrificial) and
stain protection, ultra-violet, and freeze-thaw protection and overall natural appearance
preservation.

[Elastomeric Coatings]

### Elastomeric
### Coatings

**Elastomeric Coatings** based on waterbased polymeric hybrids of acrylic and silicone systems are
popular on bridging gaps and used on inside containment and vault structures for flexural tensile
strength, and have both dampproof and waterproof performance characteristics with improved visual
appearances.

**Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings** based on acrylic hybrid polymers are
environmental compliant systems, available as a sacrificial protection solution supplied in either
clear or tinted form, and can be matched to any color standards, including common DOT Federal 595
standards.

### High Performance Epoxy Coatings

**High Performance Epoxy Coatings** based on Bisphenol A & F and higher grade types such as Novolacs
are sometimes used requiring superior chemical resistance, hydrostatic resistance, and the ability
to withstand other forms of environmental exposures on a more frequent basis.

**Integral Admixtures** based on high molecular weight Silicone emulsions of various type
composition is ideal for cementitious mix designs for integral water and corrosion protection, ideal
for frequently exposed moisture conditions.

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

[Read More][45]

The company produces a range of resins, especially Alkyd resins, which are included in many types of
paints in the way and proportion that suits the needs and requirements of these paints

## Three stucco systems, three different repairs

Getting the system right before touching the wall is half the job:
* **Traditional three-coat** — paper, wire lath, then roughly 3/4” of cement scratch and brown coat
  plus a finish coat. Most Las Cruces homes built before about 2000, and most custom and
  pueblo-style houses.
* **One-coat** — a single ~1/2” cement basecoat over foam sheathing. Common on newer production
  homes in Sonoma Ranch, High Range, and the East Mesa subdivisions. Thinner, so impacts and
  cracking telegraph faster.
* **Synthetic / EIFS** — foam board, fiberglass mesh in polymer cement, acrylic finish. Softer, and
  it traps water badly when sealant joints fail. EIFS gets repaired with EIFS components — never
  patched with cement stucco, and vice versa.

deteriorates behind the cement. Those walls need lime or mud plaster, and we’re straight with you

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### WHO WE ARE                                                                                      
                                                                                                    
Welcome to the home of LymTal International and the **Iso-Flex **brand of products.                 
                                                                                                    
LymTal International was founded by Frank Lymburner and Magdy Talaat, two senior executives of the  
Harry S. Peterson Co. **(HSP),** a nationally known manufacturer and installer of waterproofing     
products established in 1929.                                                                       
                                                                                                    
In 1994, LymTal purchased the manufacturing, research and warehouse facilities of HSP and absorbed  
much of the experienced workforce at these facilities.                                              
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"Our success is based on inovative solutions which come from ongoing research and development       
combined with field experience. The objective is to be on the leading edge of technology. We are."  
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────





────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### WHAT WE OFFER                                                                                   
                                                                                                    
With over 50 years experience, LymTal provides innovative solutions utilizing the latest polymer    
technologies to create the highest quality products in the industry. Our expert technical service   
and support combined with dedication to both Research & Development and manufacturing excellence    
ensures product consistency and quality. To that end, all of our Iso-Flex products are developed and
manufactured in a controlled environment within our own USA based facilities.                       
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Our combination of manufacturing and construction experience brings unique benefits to engineers,   
owners and contractors. The Iso-Flex product line of traffic coatings, roof coatings, sealants,     
penetrating sealers and expansion joint systems provides a complete package of products for the     
protection of concrete structures.                                                                  
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
In addition to its premier **Iso-Flex** product line, **LymTal** is constantly expanding its role by
providing innovative and custom new products, private labeling, toll manufacturing, and toll        
packaging services.                                                                                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
For further information on all of LymTal's products and services, please choose from one of our four
operating divisions by clicking on the provided links above.                                        
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How can I tell if I need a new roof or if repairs will suffice?

Determining whether you need a full [roof replacement][63] or if repairs will suffice depends on
several factors. Age, extent of damage, and the overall condition of your roof play a significant
role. Our experienced roofers at My Florida Roofing Contractor will conduct a comprehensive
inspection, assessing factors like shingle condition, granule loss, curling, buckling, and potential
water damage. We’ll provide an honest assessment and recommend the most cost-effective solution,
whether it’s targeted repairs or a full replacement.

### What should I do if my roof is damaged after a hurricane or tropical storm in Vero Beach?

If your roof sustains damage from a hurricane or tropical storm in Vero Beach, it’s crucial to act
quickly. First, ensure the safety of your family and secure any loose materials or debris. Next,
contact your insurance provider to initiate a claim process. Then, reach out to a reputable local
roofing contractor like My Florida Roofing Contractor to schedule a thorough inspection and estimate
for repairs or replacement. Prompt action can prevent further damage and ensure your home is
properly protected.

### How can I prepare my roof for hurricane season in Vero Beach?

Preparing your roof for hurricane season in Vero Beach is crucial to minimize potential damage.
Start by [scheduling a professional][64] roof inspection to identify and address any existing issues
or vulnerabilities. Ensure your roof is properly secured, with no loose shingles or flashing. Trim
overhanging branches that could potentially fall on your roof during high winds. Additionally,
consider installing impact-resistant roofing materials or hurricane straps for added protection.
Regular maintenance and proactive measures can significantly reduce the risk of storm-related roof
damage.

commercial or industrial projects with minimal lead time. If you have a 100,000 square foot project,

Waterproofing Insulating Ceramic Paints and Coatings. Starting out as a local family paint store and

products. The introduction of ceramics has helped Nationwide lead the way in developing this new
paint and coating technology. Our eco-friendly lineup is made in the USA and we currently

## ABOUT NIPSEA GROUP

60+ Years of experience

NIPSEA Group is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry.
Headquartered in Singapore, with more than 148 NIPSEA companies spread throughout 28 geographical
locations, the group is Asia Pacific’s No. 1 paint and coatings manufacturer in both production and
sales revenue. After more than 60 years of growth, NIPSEA Group has over 31,000 employees with 118
manufacturing facilities and operations, efficiently serving all aspects of the business, from
production to customer satisfaction. With a focus on maximizing value to our customers, we push
boundaries to deliver high quality solutions that work better for all our partners, tradesmen, and
homeowners. The NIPSEA Group’s arsenal of solutions for the industry covers Architectural,
Industrial, Automotive and Marine Coatings, as well as a range of products beyond the world of paint
and coatings. We have an unyielding drive to focus on customers, providing innovation that works
best for all our stakeholders.

in Julian and Alpine crack stucco. We know the county, the substrates, and which paint systems
actually hold up here.

## What do homeowners ask about painting in San Diego?

[ All FAQs ][47]
What areas in San Diego County do you paint?

We paint every city in San Diego County, from coastal communities like Encinitas, Carlsbad, and La
Jolla, to inland cities like San Marcos, Escondido, and Poway, through East County (El Cajon, La
Mesa, Santee), South Bay (Chula Vista, National City), and the mountain communities. If you're in
the county, we cover you.

How much does interior painting cost?

Single rooms run $650–$1,400 depending on wall height, trim detail, and prep needed. A full-interior
3-bedroom repaint usually lands $3,800–$6,500 with two coats on walls, ceilings, and trim. We walk
the home, measure, and give a written flat-rate quote, no square-foot estimating games.

How much does exterior painting cost?

Single-story stucco homes start around $4,800. Two-story homes from $7,500. Elastomeric premium adds
about $1,000 on top of standard acrylic for crack-prone walls. Pressure wash and prep are included.
Exterior work typically takes 3–7 days depending on prep and weather.

What paint do you use?

Sherwin-Williams Emerald or SuperPaint for walls, Pro Classic enamel for trim, Emerald Urethane for
cabinets. Benjamin Moore Regal, Aura, and Advance available on request. All low-VOC. For stucco we
spec Loxon XP or elastomeric. We don't cut to builder-grade paint on customer jobs.

How fast can you come out for an estimate?

Usually within 2–3 business days. In-home estimates are free and typically take 30–45 minutes. If
color consultation is part of the conversation, we bring large-format samples so you can see actual
paint in your actual light, not a swatch under fluorescent store lighting.

Presto Restoration Products & Services specializes in providing commercial building exterior facade
restoration services for architectural glass, metal and stone surfaces nationwide. 

Presto Restoration Products & Services is the nation's premier commercial building facade
restoration, maintenance & cleaning service company. Presto's team prides itself on providing the
highest quality workmanship safely and professionally while maintaining affordable prices. In order
to provide the best services possible, Presto utilizes the latest and most innovative building
restoration, maintenance and cleaning product technologies.

For over 25 years, Presto has been recognized in the commercial building services industry for
delivering unparalleled results in refinishing glass, metal, and stone surfaces. This achievement is
due to our proprietary chemical product line and extensive experience. Our products and
methodologies offer the longest-lasting return on investment for our customers. We excel in
providing top-quality building restoration, maintenance, and cleaning services for commercial office
buildings and are proud to have serviced some of the finest commercial properties in the United
States.

## Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine

Following the closing of the acquisition of the Sika European Industrial Coatings Business, we are
pleased to present our new website in the Sherwin-Williams corporate design.

Founded in 1866, Sherwin-Williams is a leading global paint and coatings manufacturer with 64,000+
employees across 120+ countries. In its 150-year-plus history, Sherwin-Williams has been committed
to enhancing our customers’ operations and accelerating their business growth with innovative,
high-performance coating solutions, world-class industry expertise, and unparalleled technical,
specification and commercial service.

Supported by 12 factories and nine research and development centres across Europe, the
Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Division delivers smart asset protection to customers in a wide
array of markets, including Oil & Gas, Water & Wastewater, Bridge & Highway, Steel Fabrication,
Flooring, Food & Beverage, Mining, Rail, Marine, Power Generation and Fire Protection. From alkyds
to zincs, Sherwin-Williams offers a complete line of time-tested, high-performance coatings and
systems to combat corrosion, supported by the largest group of NACE-certified coating inspectors in
the industry.

Our customers and partners will continue to enjoy the established relationships with their
knowledgeable Sika Industrial Coatings team members, and gain additional benefits that come with
becoming part of the Sherwin-Williams family. This includes access to a global team of leading
industry experts, an expanded portfolio of high-performance coatings, a broad array of specification
approvals, and an unparalleled distribution network worldwide.

We look forward to the opportunity to serve you and your company’s asset protection needs.

# Elastomeric Roof Coatings

Last updated: May 31, 2026

EmailCopy link

## Overview

Tearing off and replacing a commercial low-slope roof costs $5 to $12 per square foot and takes the
building offline for days or weeks. An elastomeric coating system on a sound substrate restores the
roof for $2 to $5 per square foot installed, with no occupant disruption, extends service life 10 to
20 years, and can qualify the assembly for cool-roof energy credit under codes like California Title
24 and ASHRAE 90.1. This guide covers when a coating system is the right call, the four chemistry
families to choose from, and what to expect on substrate fit, cost, application, and code
compliance.

Elastomeric roof coatings are liquid-applied waterproof membranes that stretch and recover with the
roof as temperatures change. They use polymer binders — acrylic, silicone, polyurethane, or
synthetic rubber — to form a seamless, flexible film that bonds directly to the existing roof
surface. Building owners, facility managers, property management firms, and commercial roofing
contractors use them on flat and low-slope roofs, metal roofs, built-up roofs, modified bitumen, and
spray foam systems.

# Elastomeric Roof Coatings

Last updated: May 31, 2026

EmailCopy link

## Overview

Tearing off and replacing a commercial low-slope roof costs $5 to $12 per square foot and takes the
building offline for days or weeks. An elastomeric coating system on a sound substrate restores the
roof for $2 to $5 per square foot installed, with no occupant disruption, extends service life 10 to
20 years, and can qualify the assembly for cool-roof energy credit under codes like California Title
24 and ASHRAE 90.1. This guide covers when a coating system is the right call, the four chemistry
families to choose from, and what to expect on substrate fit, cost, application, and code
compliance.

Elastomeric roof coatings are liquid-applied waterproof membranes that stretch and recover with the
roof as temperatures change. They use polymer binders — acrylic, silicone, polyurethane, or
synthetic rubber — to form a seamless, flexible film that bonds directly to the existing roof
surface. Building owners, facility managers, property management firms, and commercial roofing
contractors use them on flat and low-slope roofs, metal roofs, built-up roofs, modified bitumen, and
spray foam systems.

**Key point:** A coating is not a patch for a failing roof. The substrate must be structurally
sound, properly draining, and free of moisture damage before coating. All cracks, open seams, and
flashings need repair first. See the "Is your roof a candidate?" section below for the full
screening criteria.

## Is your roof a candidate?

A coating restores a roof; it does not rebuild one. Before specifying a coating system, walk the
roof and check the following criteria. If any of the disqualifiers apply, the right answer is repair
or tear-off, not coating.

### Good candidate
* Substrate is structurally sound — no soft spots, no deck deflection, no insulation saturation
* Drainage is functional — water clears within 48 hours of rain in most areas
* Existing roof is at or past mid-life but not failing — coating extends, it does not rescue
* Cracks, open seams, and flashings are repairable with sealant, fabric reinforcement, or targeted
  patching
* Roof type is one this guide covers (built-up, modified bitumen, single-ply, metal, spray foam,
  concrete) — see Substrate Compatibility for the full matrix
* You can hit the manufacturer-required mil thickness — typically two coats at 20 to 30 mils dry
  film thickness

### Disqualifiers — fix or replace, do not coat
* Trapped moisture in the insulation layer — coating over wet insulation traps moisture and
  accelerates deck rot
* Standing water that does not clear in 48 hours and cannot be corrected with drainage repair
* Active leaks from large holes, failed seams, or structural damage — repair first, coat after
* Substrate at end of service life (asphalt shingles past 20 years, single-ply with chalking and
  cracking, BUR with widespread blistering)
* Adhesion test fails — if the coating peels off cleanly after a 24-hour cure, the substrate is
  incompatible or contaminated
* Roof slope below 1/4-inch per foot with no plan for added drainage or fabric reinforcement at low
  spots

**Adhesion test before specifying:** apply a small patch of the candidate coating to a
representative area, let it cure 24 to 48 hours, then try to peel it off. Clean release means the
substrate is contaminated or incompatible — the rework cost on a full coating job that fails dwarfs
the cost of one pre-bid test patch.

## Types of Elastomeric Coatings

Four coating chemistries cover the vast majority of commercial and residential applications. Each
has trade-offs around ponding water tolerance, recoatability, and cost.

### Acrylic

Water-based [acrylic latex coatings][98] are the most common and budget-friendly option. They offer
high reflectivity and UV protection, making them a solid choice for warehouses, schools, and light
commercial buildings with proper roof slope and drainage. Cleanup is easy (soap and water), and
recoating with acrylic down the road is straightforward. The main limitation is ponding water.
Standing water can soften acrylic film over time, so these coatings work best on roofs that drain
within 48 hours after rain.

### Silicone

[Silicone coatings][99] are the go-to for roofs with ponding water problems. The polysiloxane
chemistry is naturally hydrophobic and UV stable, so silicone handles standing water and sun
exposure better than any other coating type. High-solids silicone can often be applied in a single
pass. The downsides: silicone attracts dirt (reducing reflectivity over time), the cured surface can
be slippery when wet, and it costs more per square foot. Future recoats require abrasion or a

Rio Rancho Stucco Repair fixes cracked, stained, hollow, and failing stucco on homes across Rio
Rancho and the Albuquerque metro — from a **$200–$800 crack repair** to parapet rebuilds and full
restucco at **$6–$9 per square foot**. We publish our price ranges, we identify your stucco system
before anyone touches the wall, and repairs are performed by licensed, insured New Mexico stucco
contractors. Send photos of the damage and get a fast, honest quote.

Almost every home in Rio Rancho is stucco. The 1960s and 70s houses in the original Rio Rancho
Estates core, the 1990s production homes off Southern and Golf Course, the 2000s master-planned
streets of Cabezon and Loma Colorado, the newer builds pushing out past Unser and Paseo del Volcan —
stucco, all of it. Which means when an exterior fails here, it fails as stucco: cracks that map
across a sun-baked wall, a parapet cap crumbling on a flat-roof pueblo, a rust stain fanning down
from a canale, a chalky color coat that hasn’t looked right since the Obama administration. That’s
the work we do.

## What we repair
* **[Stucco crack repair][22]** — hairline to structural cracks cut back, filled correctly, and
  refinished so water stays out. The most common call in Rio Rancho.
* **[Stucco patching][23]** — blown-out and hollow areas rebuilt from the paper and lath up, not
  skimmed over.
* **[Parapet repair][24]** — failed caps and canale leaks on flat-roof homes. The highest-stakes
  stucco problem in New Mexico.
* **[Restucco and recoating][25]** — a new finish coat or full restucco for walls that are faded,
  map-cracked, or past patching.
* **[Elastomeric coating][26]** — a flexible waterproof membrane that bridges hairline cracks and
  seals the whole wall.
* **[Color and texture matching][27]** — repairs blended into the existing wall so the patch doesn’t
  announce itself.

## Why stucco fails in Rio Rancho specifically

**The elevation works the wall year-round.** Rio Rancho sits around 5,300 feet. High-desert winters
put a stucco wall through dozens of freeze-thaw cycles a season — water sits in a hairline crack,
freezes overnight, expands, and pries the crack a little wider. Add 30–40°F daily temperature swings
that flex the finish coat spring and fall, and you get the map-cracking you see on so many
west-facing walls here.

**Monsoon rain finds every flaw.** The Albuquerque metro only gets about 8–9 inches of rain a year,
but more than half of it arrives in July through September as hard, wind-driven thunderstorms. A
crack or failed sealant joint that stayed dry for nine months suddenly takes water sideways. This is
when leak calls, stained parapets, and soft spots below canales all show up at once — and why the
smart move is fixing cracks in spring, before the first storm.

Why Choose Us

## Long-Lasting Roof Coating Results You Can Depend On

Roofing materials in Union Pier, MI expand and contract daily, stressing seams and fasteners until
they fail. A flexible roof coating system absorbs this movement, maintaining a continuous seal that
traditional materials cannot match. We specialize in surface preparation, a step that dictates the
success or failure of the entire project. Our team uses industrial-grade cleaners and primers to
ensure the new coating fuses with the old surface.
* **Rust treatment:** We neutralize rust on metal decks with phosphoric acid before applying metal
  roof coating, ensuring a stable base for the waterproofing layer.
* **Energy efficiency:** We apply cool roof coating system layers that meet high solar reflectance
  standards, helping to lower building cooling costs.
* **Seamless application:** Our seamless roof coating prevents leaks by eliminating the seams found

Presto Restoration Products & Services specializes in commercial waterproofing services for glass,
metal and stone surfaces in Albuquerque, NM. 

Presto has decades of experience protecting commercial buildings and helping them look their best.
Waterproofing the exterior of a commercial building is one of the best ways to ensure both. Our
industry leading commercial building waterproofing services include the application of various types
of caulking and coating on all exterior surfaces. Our expert commercial building waterproofing
contractors will apply a durable and long-lasting protective barrier.

Professional waterproofing services are the most cost-effective way to protect your commercial
building. Water damage to the exterior of the building and leaks can be costly to repair. Leaks can
lead to even more problems like mold and high energy bills. Don’t’ waste time and money chasing
leaks after they happen, find a professional you can trust. We are the leading Albuquerque, NM
commercial building waterproofing services provider no matter the surface or façade type. 

Our expertise comes from working with Albuquerque, NM commercial building owners and property
managers on all types of commercial buildings. We have protected condominiums, hotels, office
buildings, entertainment venues, and parking garages. We handle all large-scale commercial
waterproofing projects on everything from new construction to historic buildings. 

Call us today to learn more about how our commercial building waterproofing services can keep your
commercial building protected and looking its best.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

Learn More

### Breakthrough Performance

business owns a track record of success no other company can match.

Learn More

### Tomorrow Realized

Learn More

better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

Learn More

## Filtration Technologies


An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and
wastewater more efficient and economical.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Alas & Bravo is a roofing contractor that is located in Irvine, and serves all of Orange County.

 

We simplify what is out of reach for our clients through the close communication we establish during
the scope of our projects. 

 

We provide guidance and a great understanding of any type of roof repair, maintenance, or
installation.

 

One of the most important components to the longevity of a roof is the craftsmanship that goes into
it, not the cost of the brand or style of the materials.

 

It also requires an awareness of a home’s environment and community. By choosing our team to work
with you, you can expect the craftsmanship of a fine installation and the security that comes from
working with professionals.

#### Shingle Roofs

At Arizona Roofing Systems, we are highly skilled and experienced in shingle roof services. Shingle
roofs are an attractive and cost-effective choice for many homeowners and businesses in Arizona.
Shingle roofs are durable, weather-resistant, and can effectively protect your building from
Arizona’s harsh sun and occasional heavy rains.

[Experienced Mesa tile roofers]

#### Tile Roofs

Tile roofs are a distinctive feature of many homes and commercial buildings in Arizona, offering
exceptional beauty, durability, and longevity. Our team of professionals understands the unique
challenges and requirements of installing tile roofs. Trust us to handle your tile roof repair,
replacement, or installation with meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality.

[Foam Roof Installation]

As a leader in roofing solutions, Arizona Roofing Systems also offers foam roofing services. Foam
roofs, known for their excellent insulation properties and waterproof capabilities, are a popular
choice for many Arizona residents. This type of roofing system helps to reduce energy costs and
protect your building from heat and UV damage.

[Mesa flat and foam roof installation]

#### Flat Roofing

Specializing in flat roofing systems, Arizona Roofing Systems provides expert solutions tailored to
the unique needs of flat roofs. This type of roofing is common in commercial buildings, but is also
found in residential structures in Arizona. From small-scale repairs to large-scale installations
and replacements, we ensure a smooth and efficient process.

single-ply roofing systems are highly favored in commercial settings due to their durability, energy
efficiency, and resistance to UV rays, chemicals, and fire. Our team has extensive knowledge and
expertise in TPO/PVC roof installations, repairs, and maintenance.

[Modified Bitumen Roof installation][Modified Bitumen Roof installation]

#### Modified Bitumen Roofs

Our expertise extends to modified bitumen roofing systems, a popular choice for many commercial
buildings due to their superior waterproofing characteristics, toughness, and flexibility. We use
the best practices and highest-quality materials to provide a durable, weather-resistant roof that
fits your specific commercial needs.

[Metal Roof repair and maintenance]

Metal roofs are known for their remarkable durability, weather resistance, and energy efficiency,
making them an excellent choice for commercial establishments in Arizona. Our team has extensive
experience and training in handling various metal roof systems, ensuring a flawless installation,
effective repair, and timely maintenance.

# Colorama Coatings

### Not just paint, but real protection

Over the past 25 years we have developed an extensive range of high-quality paints and coatings
utilising the latest manufacturing technology aided by a strong research and development ethos. Our
products are used in a number of industrial, retail, housing and hospitality settings in Egypt and
around the world.

## Pioneering excellence in coatings Since 1997

Founded in 1997 with the establishment of our paints factory in Borg El Arab Industrial City,
Alexandria, Egypt, Colorama Coatings has evolved into a key player in the coatings industry in
Egypt. Through strategic collaborations with leading European and American multinational companies,
we’ve expanded our product range beyond architectural and decorative paints to include specialised
industrial, protective, and marine coating systems. Our commitment to quality through innovation has
driven our continuous growth, transforming Colorama into an agile organisation capable of swiftly
responding to market demands and customer requirements.

## Innovation-driven quality protection coatings

Today, Colorama Coatings stands as a leader in protection technology, made possible by our dedicated
R&D team in Egypt and partnerships with premier formulators across Europe and the USA. This ardent
focus on research enables us to develop bespoke solutions for any coating challenge, precisely
tailored to fulfil diverse customer specifications. Our elastomeric coatings rival those of
internationally renowned brands, delivering equivalent performance at competitive value. Advanced
thermal and waterproofing coating systems represent the latest addition to our comprehensive product
portfolio, specifically engineered to meet the rigorous demands of the petrochemical and energy
industries.

## CERTIFCATES

## Our products

###### Resins & Alkyds

We supply high quality alkyds to our coatings’ plants and other customers as well as epoxy,
polyurethane and acrylic resin.

[ DETAILS ][48]

###### Wood coatings

We produce a range of wood paints and varnishes designed for enhancing appearance, durability and
performance.

[ DETAILS ][49]

###### Decorative coatings

Our acclaimed and versatile interior and exterior range of paints are designed for durability and
harsh environmental conditions.

[ DETAILS ][50]

###### Roof coatings

Our Elastomeric and Acrylic roof coatings offer an excellent protective layer and are designed to
enhance performance, appearance and durability.

[ DETAILS ][51]

###### Marine coatings

Marine coatings are specialised protective paints designed to safeguard ships, boats, and offshore
structures from harsh marine environments.

[ DETAILS ][52]

###### Industrial coatings

Our industrial coatings range is used in various applications including protection from corrosion,
chemical and environmental damage.

[ DETAILS ][53]

###### Thermal insulation coatings

These coating are designed to provide thermal protection for tanks, vessels, boilers, pipelines as
well as roof and warehouse insulation.

[ DETAILS ][54]

###### Fireproofing coatings

We supply fire protection water-based acrylic intumescent paints for protecting structural steel as
well as epoxies for wood and textile protection.

[ DETAILS ][55]

###### Floor coatings

Our floor coatings provide enhanced performance, appearance and durability for factory floors and
other heavily trafficked areas.

[ DETAILS ][56]

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production

### Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings

**Dampproof and Waterproof Coatings** based on asphaltic-bituminous emulsion and polymer hybrids are
functional products used on specific applications, requiring certain performance characteristics.

[Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers]

### Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers

**Densifiers and Penetrating Sealers** based on hybrid systems of Silane, Siloxane, Flourinated,
Lithium and Potassium Silicates are ideal for water repellency, anti-graffiti (non-sacrificial) and
stain protection, ultra-violet, and freeze-thaw protection and overall natural appearance
preservation.

[Elastomeric Coatings]

### Elastomeric
### Coatings

**Elastomeric Coatings** based on waterbased polymeric hybrids of acrylic and silicone systems are
popular on bridging gaps and used on inside containment and vault structures for flexural tensile
strength, and have both dampproof and waterproof performance characteristics with improved visual
appearances.

[Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings]

### Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings

**Film Forming Sealers and Anti-Graffiti Coatings** based on acrylic hybrid polymers are
environmental compliant systems, available as a sacrificial protection solution supplied in either
clear or tinted form, and can be matched to any color standards, including common DOT Federal 595
standards.

[High Performance Epoxy Coatings]

### High Performance Epoxy Coatings

**High Performance Epoxy Coatings** based on Bisphenol A & F and higher grade types such as Novolacs
are sometimes used requiring superior chemical resistance, hydrostatic resistance, and the ability
to withstand other forms of environmental exposures on a more frequent basis.

[Integral Admixtures]

### Integral
### Admixtures

**Integral Admixtures** based on high molecular weight Silicone emulsions of various type
composition is ideal for cementitious mix designs for integral water and corrosion protection, ideal
for frequently exposed moisture conditions.

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural

technologies to create the highest quality products in the industry. Our expert technical service   
and support combined with dedication to both Research & Development and manufacturing excellence    
ensures product consistency and quality. To that end, all of our Iso-Flex products are developed and
manufactured in a controlled environment within our own USA based facilities.

Our combination of manufacturing and construction experience brings unique benefits to engineers,   
owners and contractors. The Iso-Flex product line of traffic coatings, roof coatings, sealants,     
penetrating sealers and expansion joint systems provides a complete package of products for the     
protection of concrete structures.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How can I tell if I need a new roof or if repairs will suffice?

Determining whether you need a full [roof replacement][63] or if repairs will suffice depends on
several factors. Age, extent of damage, and the overall condition of your roof play a significant
role. Our experienced roofers at My Florida Roofing Contractor will conduct a comprehensive
inspection, assessing factors like shingle condition, granule loss, curling, buckling, and potential
water damage. We’ll provide an honest assessment and recommend the most cost-effective solution,
whether it’s targeted repairs or a full replacement.

### What should I do if my roof is damaged after a hurricane or tropical storm in Vero Beach?

If your roof sustains damage from a hurricane or tropical storm in Vero Beach, it’s crucial to act
quickly. First, ensure the safety of your family and secure any loose materials or debris. Next,
contact your insurance provider to initiate a claim process. Then, reach out to a reputable local
roofing contractor like My Florida Roofing Contractor to schedule a thorough inspection and estimate
for repairs or replacement. Prompt action can prevent further damage and ensure your home is
properly protected.

### How can I prepare my roof for hurricane season in Vero Beach?

Preparing your roof for hurricane season in Vero Beach is crucial to minimize potential damage.
Start by [scheduling a professional][64] roof inspection to identify and address any existing issues
or vulnerabilities. Ensure your roof is properly secured, with no loose shingles or flashing. Trim
overhanging branches that could potentially fall on your roof during high winds. Additionally,
consider installing impact-resistant roofing materials or hurricane straps for added protection.
Regular maintenance and proactive measures can significantly reduce the risk of storm-related roof
damage.

What areas in San Diego County do you paint?

We paint every city in San Diego County, from coastal communities like Encinitas, Carlsbad, and La
Jolla, to inland cities like San Marcos, Escondido, and Poway, through East County (El Cajon, La
Mesa, Santee), South Bay (Chula Vista, National City), and the mountain communities. If you're in
the county, we cover you.

How much does interior painting cost?

Single rooms run $650–$1,400 depending on wall height, trim detail, and prep needed. A full-interior
3-bedroom repaint usually lands $3,800–$6,500 with two coats on walls, ceilings, and trim. We walk
the home, measure, and give a written flat-rate quote, no square-foot estimating games.

How much does exterior painting cost?

Single-story stucco homes start around $4,800. Two-story homes from $7,500. Elastomeric premium adds
about $1,000 on top of standard acrylic for crack-prone walls. Pressure wash and prep are included.
Exterior work typically takes 3–7 days depending on prep and weather.

What paint do you use?

Sherwin-Williams Emerald or SuperPaint for walls, Pro Classic enamel for trim, Emerald Urethane for
cabinets. Benjamin Moore Regal, Aura, and Advance available on request. All low-VOC. For stucco we
spec Loxon XP or elastomeric. We don't cut to builder-grade paint on customer jobs.

How fast can you come out for an estimate?

Usually within 2–3 business days. In-home estimates are free and typically take 30–45 minutes. If
color consultation is part of the conversation, we bring large-format samples so you can see actual
paint in your actual light, not a swatch under fluorescent store lighting.

restoration, maintenance and cleaning product technologies.

delivering unparalleled results in refinishing glass, metal, and stone surfaces. This achievement is
due to our proprietary chemical product line and extensive experience. Our products and
methodologies offer the longest-lasting return on investment for our customers. We excel in
providing top-quality building restoration, maintenance, and cleaning services for commercial office
buildings and are proud to have serviced some of the finest commercial properties in the United

### National Leader in Commercial Building Restoration & Envelope Protection

Presto Restoration is a nationwide, non-union commercial contractor with over 25 years of experience
in high-rise restoration. We provide complete exterior envelope protection, from the roof to the
parking deck, specializing in commercial building restoration, leak remediation, architectural
surface refinishing, and waterproofing for commercial, industrial, and historic assets.

### Core Commercial Capabilities:

**- Commercial Waterproofing & Coatings: **Complete building envelope protection including wet
glazing, window perimeter caulking, and the application of elastomeric and acrylic exterior coatings
for long-term weatherproofing.

**- Parking Deck Restoration: ** Turnkey garage maintenance services, including traffic coating
application, control and expansion joint replacement, concrete patching/repair, and striping.

**- Commercial Roofing Systems:** Installation and maintenance of commercial roof systems,
specializing in Silicone Roof Coatings to extend asset lifespan and prevent water intrusion.

**- Architectural Surface Restoration:** Proprietary restoration services for Commercial Glass
(stain/scratch removal) ^{}, Metal Panels (anodized aluminum frame restoration), and Stone Facades
(precast cleaning & sealing)^{}.

**- Consulting & Leak Detection:** Forensic building envelope inspections and water intrusion
testing to identify failure points. We provide project management and custom exterior maintenance
plans for property managers^{}.

Following the closing of the acquisition of the Sika European Industrial Coatings Business, we are
pleased to present our new website in the Sherwin-Williams corporate design.

Founded in 1866, Sherwin-Williams is a leading global paint and coatings manufacturer with 64,000+
employees across 120+ countries. In its 150-year-plus history, Sherwin-Williams has been committed
to enhancing our customers’ operations and accelerating their business growth with innovative,
high-performance coating solutions, world-class industry expertise, and unparalleled technical,
specification and commercial service.

Supported by 12 factories and nine research and development centres across Europe, the
Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Division delivers smart asset protection to customers in a wide
array of markets, including Oil & Gas, Water & Wastewater, Bridge & Highway, Steel Fabrication,
Flooring, Food & Beverage, Mining, Rail, Marine, Power Generation and Fire Protection. From alkyds
to zincs, Sherwin-Williams offers a complete line of time-tested, high-performance coatings and
systems to combat corrosion, supported by the largest group of NACE-certified coating inspectors in
the industry.

Our customers and partners will continue to enjoy the established relationships with their
knowledgeable Sika Industrial Coatings team members, and gain additional benefits that come with
becoming part of the Sherwin-Williams family. This includes access to a global team of leading
industry experts, an expanded portfolio of high-performance coatings, a broad array of specification
approvals, and an unparalleled distribution network worldwide.

We look forward to the opportunity to serve you and your company’s asset protection needs.

it's smart to choose Rhino Shield to get the job done right.** Since 2000, Rhino Shield has grown to
become nationally recognized as a leader in premium exterior coatings and paint products. Our
innovative formula protects your property against the elements while giving it a beautiful finish,

Elastomeric roof coatings are liquid-applied waterproof membranes that stretch and recover with the

* Trapped moisture in the insulation layer — coating over wet insulation traps moisture and

* Substrate at end of service life (asphalt shingles past 20 years, single-ply with chalking and
  cracking, BUR with widespread blistering)
* Adhesion test fails — if the coating peels off cleanly after a 24-hour cure, the substrate is
  incompatible or contaminated
* Roof slope below 1/4-inch per foot with no plan for added drainage or fabric reinforcement at low

**Adhesion test before specifying:** apply a small patch of the candidate coating to a
representative area, let it cure 24 to 48 hours, then try to peel it off. Clean release means the
substrate is contaminated or incompatible — the rework cost on a full coating job that fails dwarfs
the cost of one pre-bid test patch.

## Types of Elastomeric Coatings

Four coating chemistries cover the vast majority of commercial and residential applications. Each
has trade-offs around ponding water tolerance, recoatability, and cost.

### Acrylic

Water-based [acrylic latex coatings][98] are the most common and budget-friendly option. They offer
high reflectivity and UV protection, making them a solid choice for warehouses, schools, and light
commercial buildings with proper roof slope and drainage. Cleanup is easy (soap and water), and
recoating with acrylic down the road is straightforward. The main limitation is ponding water.
Standing water can soften acrylic film over time, so these coatings work best on roofs that drain
within 48 hours after rain.

### Silicone

[Silicone coatings][99] are the go-to for roofs with ponding water problems. The polysiloxane
chemistry is naturally hydrophobic and UV stable, so silicone handles standing water and sun

Rio Rancho Stucco Repair fixes cracked, stained, hollow, and failing stucco on homes across Rio
Rancho and the Albuquerque metro — from a **$200–$800 crack repair** to parapet rebuilds and full
restucco at **$6–$9 per square foot**. We publish our price ranges, we identify your stucco system
before anyone touches the wall, and repairs are performed by licensed, insured New Mexico stucco
contractors. Send photos of the damage and get a fast, honest quote.

Almost every home in Rio Rancho is stucco. The 1960s and 70s houses in the original Rio Rancho
Estates core, the 1990s production homes off Southern and Golf Course, the 2000s master-planned
streets of Cabezon and Loma Colorado, the newer builds pushing out past Unser and Paseo del Volcan —
stucco, all of it. Which means when an exterior fails here, it fails as stucco: cracks that map
across a sun-baked wall, a parapet cap crumbling on a flat-roof pueblo, a rust stain fanning down
from a canale, a chalky color coat that hasn’t looked right since the Obama administration. That’s
the work we do.

## What we repair
* **[Stucco crack repair][22]** — hairline to structural cracks cut back, filled correctly, and
  refinished so water stays out. The most common call in Rio Rancho.
* **[Stucco patching][23]** — blown-out and hollow areas rebuilt from the paper and lath up, not
  skimmed over.
* **[Parapet repair][24]** — failed caps and canale leaks on flat-roof homes. The highest-stakes
  stucco problem in New Mexico.
* **[Restucco and recoating][25]** — a new finish coat or full restucco for walls that are faded,
  map-cracked, or past patching.
* **[Elastomeric coating][26]** — a flexible waterproof membrane that bridges hairline cracks and
  seals the whole wall.
* **[Color and texture matching][27]** — repairs blended into the existing wall so the patch doesn’t
  announce itself.

## Why stucco fails in Rio Rancho specifically

**The elevation works the wall year-round.** Rio Rancho sits around 5,300 feet. High-desert winters
put a stucco wall through dozens of freeze-thaw cycles a season — water sits in a hairline crack,
freezes overnight, expands, and pries the crack a little wider. Add 30–40°F daily temperature swings
that flex the finish coat spring and fall, and you get the map-cracking you see on so many
west-facing walls here.

**Monsoon rain finds every flaw.** The Albuquerque metro only gets about 8–9 inches of rain a year,
but more than half of it arrives in July through September as hard, wind-driven thunderstorms. A
crack or failed sealant joint that stayed dry for nine months suddenly takes water sideways. This is
when leak calls, stained parapets, and soft spots below canales all show up at once — and why the
smart move is fixing cracks in spring, before the first storm.
